bookmarkletGuide.title: Set up the exporter
bookmarkletGuide.intro: The exporter is a bookmark that runs on instagram.com while you're logged in. Set it up once, then reuse it any time.
bookmarkletGuide.browserNote: Use Google Chrome. Other browsers may block the bookmark from running.
desktopSteps: Drag the “IG Export” button below to the bookmarks bar at the top of Chrome. Press Ctrl+Shift+B (Cmd+Shift+B on Mac) if you don't see the bar.
Or bookmark this page, rename it “IG Export” and replace its address with the code from “Copy exporter”.
mobileSteps: In Chrome, bookmark this page, then edit that bookmark: rename it “IG Export” and replace its address with what you copied.
desktopRun: Open instagram.com and make sure you're logged in.
Press Copy in the popup, then paste it here.
mobileRun: Open instagram.com and make sure you're logged in.
Type “IG Export” in the address bar and tap the suggestion.
Press Copy in the popup, then paste it here.

guide.title: How to export your Instagram data

slides.title: Open Your Information
slides.description: Go to Accounts Center in your settings → Your information and permissions.

slides.title: Choose Destination
slides.description: Select Export to device (recommended) or use an external service of your choosing.

slides.title: Select Data
slides.description: Choose Followers and following, set Date range to All time, and Format to JSON.

slides.title: Download File
slides.description: Once ready, download the ZIP file to your device and come back to this page. This might take a couple of minutes.
